title: Kayumars
economy: Build Kayumars’s mountain settlement around a cave in the mountainside. Start with homes, a store, a farm, five villagers, six defenders and supplies. Expand with houses, farms, a training ground, walls and timber watchtowers.
mission: Prepare at your own pace: reach 8 villagers and 8 defenders and build a watchtower. After Siamak falls, defend your people against three demon waves. Ariel fights alongside your army.

title: Hushang
economy: Fire is discovered, which unlocks the Temple and Glory. Iron unlocks the Blacksmith.
mission: Destroy the Black Demon’s lair.

title: Tahmuras
economy: Unlock taming animals: sheep, dogs, falcons.
mission: Capture 7 demon chiefs alive. They become workers and teach writing (unlocks the Library).

title: Jamshid
economy: A big city builder: unlock cloth, stone buildings, medicine, ships.
mission: Build Jamshid’s Palace (Wonder). When it’s done, the king turns proud, loses his Glory and the city rebels. Escape.

title: Zahhak, the Snake King
economy: Ariel joins two kind cooks who secretly save one young man each day. Build a hidden mountain village; each rescued man becomes a villager.
mission: Grow to 40 villagers without the king’s soldiers finding you.

title: Kaveh the Blacksmith
economy: Start in Kaveh’s shop. Build forges and recruit rebels. Forge Fereydun’s bull-headed mace.
mission: Storm the Snake King’s palace and chain him inside Mount Damavand.

title: Fereydun’s Three Sons
economy: Build Iraj’s kingdom and send gift caravans to his two brothers.
mission: The brothers kill Iraj (scripted). Save his baby daughter.

title: Revenge for Iraj
economy: Full base, with two heroes.
mission: Destroy both brothers’ Town Centers.

act: Act II: The House of Sam
title: Zal and the Simurgh
economy: A camp at the foot of a giant mountain. Spend wood and gold on bridges and ladders up the cliff.
mission: Reach the Simurgh’s nest and bring baby Zal home. The Simurgh becomes your ally.

act: Act II: The House of Sam
title: Zal and Rudabeh
economy: Zal’s city. Build a Market and trade with Kabul.
mission: Collect gold for gifts and build an Observatory so the stargazers approve the marriage. Stop the king’s army from destroying Kabul.

act: Act II: The House of Sam
title: Birth of Rostam
economy: Defend the city.
mission: Collect 300 Glory to call the Simurgh and save Rudabeh during a dangerous birth.

act: Act II: The House of Sam
title: King Nowzar
economy: A big base against a much bigger enemy army.
mission: Evacuate villagers to safety. The king dies (scripted).

act: Act II: The House of Sam
title: Rostam and Rakhsh
economy: Build stables. A giant white elephant attacks at night.
mission: Find the horse Rakhsh among wild horses, kill the elephant, destroy the enemy camp.

act: Act II: The House of Sam
title: The New King
economy: Build a forward base near the mountains.
mission: Escort the new king home, then defeat the enemy army.

title: The Demon Land
economy: Start with a big army and base.
mission: Midway, the White Demon blinds your army: the map goes dark. Rebuild while almost blind.

title: Rostam’s Seven Trials
economy: Ariel builds a supply camp after each trial.
mission: Lion, desert, dragon, witch, guide, demon general, White Demon. Free the king.

title: The Captured King
economy: A base in enemy land.
mission: Fight three enemy kingdoms and free the king from a fortress.

title: The Flying Throne
economy: Build an eagle house and gather meat. You’re secretly building the villain’s trap.
mission: The throne crashes. Find the king in the forest.

title: The Royal Hunt
economy: A hunting lodge with lots of animals.
mission: An enemy ambush: defend, then retreat.

title: Rostam and Sohrab
economy: Defend the White Castle.
mission: Three days of duels, then race to get the healing potion. You can never make it in time.

title: Walk through Fire
economy: Gather 2 mountains of wood while the queen’s spies burn your piles.
mission: The prince rides through fire to prove he’s innocent.

title: Siavash’s City
economy: Build a city from nothing. Peace treaty: no attacking allowed.
mission: Finish the city (Wonder) while enemies sabotage it.

title: Death of Siavash
economy: The city falls.
mission: Escape with the pregnant princess.

title: Rostam’s Revenge
economy: A war base.
mission: Destroy 3 enemy cities.

title: Searching for the Prince
economy: A small hidden camp. Seasons change; winter reduces food.
mission: Find the lost prince among shepherds.

title: The River Crossing
economy: Gather wood for rafts.
mission: Get everyone across the river while chased.

title: The Demon Fortress
economy: A race: an AI rival builds a base too.
mission: Capture the fortress first. The winner becomes king.

title: Forud
economy: A base near a mountain castle.
mission: Send a warning before your general attacks the king’s own brother. It fails.

title: The Giant Kamus
economy: Defend a mountain.
mission: Survive until Rostam arrives.

title: The Emperor of China
economy: A big base.
mission: A huge battle against war elephants.

title: The Wild Ass Demon
economy: Protect large herds.
mission: A demon disguised as a wild donkey attacks them. Kill it.

title: Bizhan and Manizheh
economy: A trading post. Collect gold and jewels for a fake merchant caravan.
mission: Sneak into enemy land and rescue Bizhan from a pit.

title: The Twelve Duels
economy: Base against base.
mission: Win 11 of 12 hero duels.

title: The Great War
economy: The largest map.
mission: Destroy the enemy capital.

title: The End of Afrasiyab
economy: Base at a holy fire.
mission: Capture the enemy king. Then the king disappears into a snowstorm.

title: Prince in Rome
economy: Start with nothing in a foreign land.
mission: Kill a giant wolf and a dragon to win the princess and an army.

title: The New Faith
economy: Build Temples and plant a holy tree.
mission: Survive a religious war.

title: Esfandiyar’s Seven Trials
economy: Supply camps after each trial.
mission: Capture the Brass Fortress.

title: Rostam vs Esfandiyar
economy: A base in Rostam’s homeland.
mission: Choose a side. Both endings are sad.

title: Death of Rostam
economy: A base near Kabul.
mission: You arrive too late. Take revenge on Kabul.

act: Act VII: The End of the Old Kings
title: The Baby in the River
economy: A small village by a river.
mission: A queen puts her baby in a box on the river. Follow it and save it.

act: Act VII: The End of the Old Kings
title: Darab
economy: The village grows into a kingdom.
mission: Win back the throne.

act: Act VII: The End of the Old Kings
title: Dara vs Alexander
economy: A losing war.
mission: Slow Alexander down, then evacuate.

act: Act VII: The End of the Old Kings
title: Alexander’s Journeys
economy: A huge build.
mission: Build the Great Iron Wall (Wonder) and find the Water of Life.

title: Ardashir
economy: Escape and build a new kingdom.
mission: Defeat the old king.

title: The Giant Worm
economy: Mine lead and copper.
mission: Disguise as merchants and pour melted lead into the worm’s mouth.

title: Shapur
economy: Rebuild an army from one village.
mission: Defeat the Roman Emperor.

title: The Cruel King
economy: Very high taxes drain your resources.
mission: Keep your people alive until a magic horse kills the king.

title: Bahram and the Lions
economy: A base with Arab allies.
mission: March on the capital and grab the crown from between two lions.

title: Bahram’s Adventures
economy: Lower taxes, hold festivals, bring musicians from India.
mission: A happy economy level.

title: The Night Attack
economy: Make your town look empty.
mission: A hidden army launches a surprise night attack.

title: King Piruz
economy: Two parts.
mission: First a defeat, then a general’s revenge.

title: The Famine
economy: No food. Granaries and hard choices.
mission: Survive the starvation and a revolution.

title: The Wise Minister
economy: Build the Great Palace Arch (Wonder).
mission: Solve the chess puzzle and invent backgammon.

title: The Great King’s Wars
economy: A large base.
mission: War on several fronts.

title: 12,000 vs 300,000
economy: A small army.
mission: Hold a narrow pass against a giant army.

title: The General’s Rebellion
economy: The villain splits the kingdom.
mission: Civil war.

title: The King’s Escape
economy: Build an alliance in Rome.
mission: Come back with a Roman army.

title: Khosrow and Shirin
economy: A palace economy with a court-favor meter.
mission: Court plots and betrayal.

title: The Son’s Betrayal
economy: Ariel slowly loses health as his power fades.
mission: Survive the prince’s coup.

title: Kings Fall Every Day
economy: A new king every few minutes, and each one changes the rules.
mission: Hold the kingdom together.

title: The Last King
economy: The biggest defense of the game.
mission: You lose (scripted). The last king dies, the Glory leaves Iran, and Ariel becomes mortal.
